subject: Fix undefined behavior defined by ASAN (#1451)
reason: The change is a pure undefined-behavior cleanup: every hunk replaces a function-pointer cast (calling e.g. sdsfree or streamFreeCG through an incompatible void(*)(void*) cast) with a trivially equivalent void*-typed wrapper that calls the same free function on the same object. I verified each substitution in the source: sdsfreeVoid wraps sdsfree, listReleaseVoid wraps listRelease, ACLFreeUserVoid wraps ACLFreeUser, streamFreeCGVoid wraps streamFreeCG, streamFreeConsumerVoid wraps streamFreeConsumer, engineLibraryDispose wraps engineLibraryFree, lpFreeVoid calls the same lp_free as lpFree, and
